messages:
maya: Heads up — prod-canary started showing an intermittent regression after the AWQ group-size bump. Small accuracy delta (~0.4% EM drop on our eval slice) plus occasional token stalls causing 200–300ms tail spikes. Seems tied to long-prefix requests. Screenshot: https://dash/reports/8342/overview
sven: Any logs or sample prompts?
maya: Pasted a trimmed runner excerpt: ```WARN awq_runner: group_idx=35 kv_chain_len=12 prefetch_miss=1 latency_ms=12.6 stall_ms=220 trace_id=7012
Trace: awq_executor::dispatch -> kv_cache::fetch_group -> group_merge -> decode_loop```
tara: I noticed something similar on staging after we increased group_size 64->96 last night. Not constant — shows up on ~1/2000 requests with long prefix (>= 2k tokens).
raj: Are we on AWQ v1.2.x? Which act-quant setting? Could be an act-quant × group_size interaction.
lin: Canary nodes: awq-1.2.3, group_size=96, act-quant=3. Staging that failed earlier had act-quant=2 on some hosts.
infra-bot: deploy: canary awq-1.2.3 roll 2024-05-10T03:22Z succeeded
maya: Plan suggestion: pause canary, revert group_size to 64 on canary nodes, run deterministic smoke with long-prefix (prefix_len=4096) and fixed seed set. Need to figure out if group_size or act-quant is root cause.
sven: I can kick off a bisect across group_size [64,80,96,112] × actq [2,3]. Where is the harness?
tara: Bench harness is infra/bench/long_prefix_smoke. Link: https://ci/job/long-prefix-smoke. Include `/proc/gpu` snapshot and config in the run. Also add instrumentation for per-group KV cache hit rates — I think we cross-group boundary and cause extra memcpy.
raj: Quick mitigation idea: force padding groups to power-of-two boundaries to avoid cross-group merges in the hot path. Could be low-risk patch to test.
lin: Risk: padding changes alignment and may subtly affect perf/latency. I prefer experiment first rather than blanket change in prod.
ops-bot: alert: canary-2 error-rate spiked to 0.72% at 03:40 UTC, auto-thresholds not triggered (soft-alert)
maya: I've opened a revert PR that sets group_size back to 64 for canary nodes: https://git/repo/pull/918 and queued smoke job id=8342.
sven: Starting bisect run now (job 8343). Plan: run each (group_size, actq) for 10k seeded requests against sample set A (long-prefix) and collect EM + 95p latency + stall_count. I'll post results here.
tara: Please attach failing seeds and logs. If you can reproduce locally, include the minimal reproducer for the infra team.
maya: Failing sample: prompt_id=7012 (attached). Baseline: EM=78.91%. Canary (current) EM=78.50% (-0.41%). Tail latency 95p increases from ~110ms -> ~380ms on affected nodes when stall triggers.
raj: If bisect confirms AWQ instability, fallback plan: detect stall pattern and route to INT8 runner as fallback (degrades EM ~0.2% but stabilizes latency). Prototype that locally.
lin: Let's not flip fallback in prod until we have solid reproducer. For now pause canary and run the experiments.
maya: Paused canary at 1712345705. Revert PR merged at 1712345775. Next: sven runs bisect, tara will add per-group KV metrics and extra logs, raj will prototype fallback, lin will coordinate canary resume once we have results.
sven: Bisect job started. Will post tabulated results (group_size, actq, EM, 95p latency, stall_count) when done.
tara: Adding additional trace logs to awq_executor for group boundary events and will push a patch to canary branch for the smoke run.
raj: If anyone finds a deterministic seed, ping me and I'll run fallback prototype against it.
lin: Thanks — please keep this thread as the single source of truth for the bisect outputs and PR links.
maya: tl;dr: intermittent heisenbug after group_size bump, paused canary, bisect in progress, action owners assigned. :wave:
